name: Zamja
summary: Zamja is a Darkspear troll cooking trainer found working in the bustling corridor of the Drag in Orgrimmar. Known for her steady hand with a meat cleaver, she instructs Horde adventurers in preparing hearty meals from the beasts of Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Cleaver in the Drag
sections.body: Stationed within the winding canyon path of the Drag, Zamja spends her days breaking down cuts of meat and teaching hungry Horde travelers how to sustain themselves. Practical cooking is a vital survival skill in the rugged terrain of Durotar and the Barrens, and Zamja ensures that anyone willing to hold a skillet learns the basics of turning raw game into wholesome rations. For cooks who have mastered basic recipes and seek further training, she directs them south toward Gadgetzan.

faq.answer: Zamja is a Darkspear troll cooking trainer situated in the Drag in Orgrimmar. She teaches culinary arts to members of the Horde and helps budding cooks refine their craft.
She can be found in the Drag, the shaded, winding trench connecting the Valley of Strength to the Valley of Honor within Orgrimmar.

Zamja provides cooking training and teaches recipes that allow adventurers to prepare sustenance from beasts and game gathered throughout Kalimdor. When a cook advances far enough, she also directs them toward more advanced instructors.

faq.q: Where does Zamja send advanced cooks?
faq.answer: Once a chef's skills outgrow the local training available in Orgrimmar, Zamja directs them to Gadgetzan in Tanaris via the quest 'To Gadgetzan You Go!' to seek out Dirge Quikcleave.

angles.text: Zamja is one of the primary cooking trainers for Horde characters visiting Orgrimmar, teaching essential recipes and eventually pointing seasoned cooks south to Tanaris for advanced instruction.
Like many Darkspear trolls who have settled in Orgrimmar under Warchief Thrall's banner, Zamja brings troll resourcefulness and culinary craft to the heart of the Horde capital.
